items.statement: Within the sampled first-event models, both dry stepwise orders are thermodynamically accessible, and explicit water preferentially stabilizes the electron-transfer ionic intermediate.

items.statement: The result is a thermodynamic comparison within a selected model and does not exclude PCET/HAT, establish rates, or justify precision beyond hydrated-water model sensitivity.
items.expected: The report states these interpretation limits and qualifies hydrated proton-transfer precision by model sensitivity.
